purpose: Developer evaluation protocol only; no user-facing switch or verification step.
rationale: With zero errors in 60 independent negative records, the one-sided 95% binomial upper bound is approximately 4.9%. Ten positives per category support coverage checks, not a precise per-category accuracy claim.
independence: Independently labeled after the catalog contract is fixed; no model proposals shown to labelers; no training/development/evaluation duplicates or near duplicates; preserve source/vendor grouping and reserve records before tuning.
test_once: Freeze all candidate runtime, catalog, tokenizer, model and threshold files before predictions. Register one evaluation attempt per dataset hash. Report every category and all abstention/compliance errors, including failures of targets.
threshold_policy: Existing weights and validation-selected thresholds remain unchanged. Any later training requires a designated fit split and separate validation split; never fit or select thresholds using the final test.
release_policy: A passing fresh test is required before treating this candidate as release-qualified. Development regression metrics are insufficient. Current policy source is the supplied 2014 code; later amendments are not exhaustively certified.
